verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a developer framework, since one could ship an NL-driven assistant in its CLI or Studio. The evidence only shows Mastra as a framework for building agents that end users chat with, plus building blocks such as authoring MCP servers and publishing llms.txt and docs.md for external AI tools. Nothing documents operating Mastra itself through natural-language commands, so these items are developer primitives or adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
